title: Maps from a finite simplicial set preserve filtered colimits
statement: Fix a universe $\mathcal U$. Let $K$ be a $\mathcal U$-small simplicial set with finitely many nondegenerate simplices [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]. Let $I$ be a $\mathcal U$-small filtered ordinary category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] and $D:I\to\mathrm{sSet}_{\mathcal U}$ a functor. With its degreewise colimit and cocone maps $\iota_i:D_i\to\operatorname{colim}_I D$, the canonical map $$\operatorname{colim}_{i\in I}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{sSet}}(K,D_i)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{sSet}}(K,\operatorname{colim}_{i\in I}D_i),\qquad [i,a]\longmapsto\iota_i a$$ is a bijection. Morphisms are ordinary simplicial maps, not homotopy classes. The empty simplicial set is allowed.
